coverage: Issue requirements issue:paragraph-1..4 reviewed against diff and report

findings.claim: The fix guards the remainder with `if rest and any(rest)`, which drops any nonempty remainder whose elements are all falsey (e.g. 0, None, False, empty strings). The requirement only asks to suppress an *empty* trailing group; a nonempty remainder must be preserved.
findings.impact: split_after([1, 0], lambda x: x == 1, maxsplit=1) would yield only [[1]] instead of [[1], [0]], silently losing data. The independent report's diagnostic profile seeded_falsey_remainder_v1 fails 4 of 6 cases (zero, none, false, zeros), confirming the regression.

findings.claim: The independent report shows accepted_against_baseline=false: issue and targeted checks pass, but the disclosed diagnostic checks fail (2/6 passed) and full_suite_all_passed is false. Acceptance against baseline is not met.
findings.impact: The candidate cannot be approved. Note the remaining full-suite failure test_more.TimeLimitedTests.test_zero_limit is a pre-existing baseline failure (new_failures count 0), so it is not caused by this change; the blocking issue is the falsey-remainder diagnostic failures.

unknowns: Whether the intended fix should be `if rest:` alone (preserving any nonempty remainder) was not confirmed against upstream more_itertools source.
The exact contents of the seeded_falsey_remainder_v1 diagnostic cases are not shown, only their names and pass/fail counts.
